n, m = map(int, input().split())
if n > m:
    n, m = m, n

INFINITY = 1000000000
sizeN = 1 << n

dpTable = [[INFINITY] * sizeN for _ in range(sizeN)]
for row in dpTable:
    row[0] = 0

for step in range(m):
    nextTable = [[INFINITY] * sizeN for _ in range(sizeN)]
    for prevC0 in range(sizeN):
        for prevC1 in range(sizeN):
            if dpTable[prevC0][prevC1] != INFINITY:
                limitC2 = 1 if step == m - 1 else sizeN
                for c2 in range(limitC2):
                    allBits = sizeN - 1
                    doneBits = ((allBits & (prevC1 >> 1)) |
                                (allBits & (prevC1 << 1)) |
                                prevC0 | c2)
                    doneBits &= (allBits ^ prevC1)
                    cost = dpTable[prevC0][prevC1] + n - bin(doneBits).count('1')
                    if cost < nextTable[prevC1][c2]:
                        nextTable[prevC1][c2] = cost
    dpTable = nextTable

minCost = INFINITY
for row in dpTable:
    for val in row:
        if val < minCost:
            minCost = val

print(n * m - minCost)
